description: OLE-PARAM names versus positions with different parameter types: (a) QMulti with its discovered parameters set by name in an order different from declaration (pC, pY, pA, pD, pB), executed, then with a string and an integer swapped between pA and pB; (b) 'SELECT ID, Code FROM Items WHERE Code = ? AND ID = ?' with parameters appended integer-named-pID first then text-named-pCode, then in marker order, then with NamedParameters = True; (c) 'PARAMETERS pB Text(10), pA Long; SELECT ID, Code FROM Items WHERE L = pA AND Code = pB;' with manual parameters appended pA first, and again appended pB first. Each is executed and its rows and Errors read. Asks whether binding is by name or by position and what a mismatch does.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
